capabilities.supported_domain: Coaxial cylindrical through/blind drilling and opposed counterbores in the counterbored_fixture recipe: counterbore radius 6..8 mm, depth 4..8 mm, plate height 18..24 mm; native parameter sweep and independently imported assembly exchange at default/min/max configurations.
exclusions: Threads, fit, preload and load capacity certification

capabilities.supported_domain: Revised bearing-supported drive module with associated drawings, dimensions, datum references, BOM and explicit exchange-loss reporting.
Bounded-memory inspection and one-part revision of declared repeated/unique assembly workloads on pinned hardware.
exclusions: Current display benchmarks do not close all scale gates
